title: Honest Feedback required for trading simulat
author: wallstreet-b
selftext:
Hi All,

  
Looking for traders to beta test an AI-powered trading simulator. It's free. Looking for honest feedback. Please give a look at [wallstreet-billionaire.com](http://wallstreet-billionaire.com) and let me know what you think. 

The market behaviour behind the price patterns/charts for equities, indexes, fx and crypto are real, not fake. Its not a random walk but actual market behaviour. 

Please let me know your thoughts about the stats, the AI Coach. Thanks a lot for your opinions.
